191wrf5.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
191wrf5.description_zh:

特别是，我们在 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆

1eqn8sa.description_en:
To all available contractors,
We at Rayari are working day and night to solve the current regen crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need rare resources that the company's suppliers cannot deliver.
We are therefore seeking a contractor to secure an irradiated valakkar egg. Our scans have confirmed several radioactive storms with known a valakkar presence on Pyro I, you can find a shuttle near [LOCATION] that will take you inside the storm. One more thing, analysis indicates that these eggs will decay over time, the state of the egg shouldn't affect our research but sooner would be better.
Due to the health risks associated with radiation exposure that will be needed to deliver a viable sample, Rayari is ready to pay well for anyone who can safely secure and deliver this item.
Once attained, please take this valuable resource to [DESTINATION].
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

9fc8.description_en:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?
See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.
I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the location marker on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.
Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least three friends onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of 16 Council Scrip to the main contractor that pulls it off.
- Stows
9fc8.description_zh:
有群杂碎想把咱们挤出星系。想不想给他们点颜色瞧瞧？

听着，有些人真的不希望我们在这待着，他们已经开始派出五到七艘船的猎杀小队，通常还会有一艘火力更强的大型战舰，跑到我们正在建立势力的地方搞事情。是时候让他们知道，我们可不是好惹的。

我在 HUD 上标记了一个<EM4>位置标记</EM4>，串起了几个地点，这些地方是我们遭遇敌对行为最频繁的区域。需要你去每个地方扫描一下，看看能不能引诱他们出来干一架。

我知道这任务不容易，所以别太自信想着单干。如果我是你，我会至少带上<EM4>三个朋友</EM4>来帮忙。为了让你觉得值，所以答应给完成任务的主承包商额外 <EM4>[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证</EM4> 作为奖励。

1aj2qc8.description_en:
We’ve got clients reporting outlaw attacks on ships around [LOCATION]. They got locked down tight and anybody heading in or out is a target. Any attempts to solve the issue have just been met with more outlaw reinforcements appearing.
The client is desperate for a solution, so we’re hiring a contractor to go and restore peace in the area. If any other issues flare up once you're there, I’ll comm you directions on how to help.
Really need someone on this fast. So to sweeten the pot, the main contractor will also get a bonus payment of 5 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

真的需要有人赶紧接手这个任务。因此为了增加吸引力，主承包商还将获得 <EM4>[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证</EM4>作为额外奖励。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
